text:
maya.marketing: Quick sync: after last webinar we saw spike in handoff SLA misses. proposing a small RR stabilization patch + enrichment-prefetch canary to even out claims.

chris-sdr: saw quite a few cold claims where company fields were missing. will prefetch help?

maya.marketing: yes, prefetch asks enrichment service on lead create and writes temp fields. claim logic will prefer leads with temp fields for a short grace window so reps see richer records.

lee-salesops: must avoid changing core RR fairness. suggest prefetch only affects claim preference, not assignment weight. also add a circuit-breaker if RR skew > 12%.

hs-sync-bot: note: new HS props required: prefetch_status (pending|done|failed) and prefetch_ts. SF mapping update needed.

noah-ops: config i'll flip for 1% canary tonight: {flag: "routing.prefetch.canary", pct: 1, prefetch_timeout_ms: 2500, prefer_window_ms: 30000, claim_lock_ms: 40000} 

chris-sdr: will reps see fields appear after claim? that confused a few folks last time.

maya.marketing: we'll add a small banner in HS and a 1-page playbook: "If enrichment appears after claim, verify before using and leave comment."

lee-salesops: metrics to watch: prefetch_success_rate, claims_with_enrich_before_claim_pct, rr_skew_percentile, claim_latency_p95. rollback if rr_skew >12% or claim_latency_p95 worsens by 20%.

noah-ops: pushing to staging now, prod canary at 6pm PT. will post +15m and +2h updates in #handoff-sla.

maya.marketing: thanks team — check-in tomorrow 9am PT to decide widen or rollback. :rocket:
